values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/blackcreek ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (nightly fee $20; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a spigot (the page's general list says a hand-pump well). Paddle-in camping: sites 3-6, 9-11, 14, 15, 17, 20 and 21 can be reached from Black Creek.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/blackcreek ('Amenities include vault toilets and potable water from a spigot', 'Sites 3-6, 9-11, 14, 15, 17, 20 and 21 are accessible from the water'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/blackcreek ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis', 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table ('Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com': no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 23 shaded sites; the DNR posts no length limit or trailer wording for this campground. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/blackcreek ('This rustic campground includes 23 shaded sites nestled along Black Creek', 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (23 campsites), read 2026-10-25. The stored 40-ft maximum is not on either DNR page; the only source found is a directory (campgroundviews.com '15 sites will accommodate 40-ft', Campendium 'Max Length 40 ft'), so it is cleared.

season.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Black Creek State Forest Campground, Midland Co.: 'Seasonal closure dates' 'Sept 25 to May 16'), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic Michigan DNR state forest campground with shaded sites on the banks of Black Creek, ~3 miles north of Sanford (11.6 miles northwest of Midland via US-10). Pine Haven Pathway (hiking, mountain biking, cross-country skiing) a five-minute drive away; near the Pere Marquette Rail Trail and Sanford Lake. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 23 sites, $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, potable water from a spigot, paddle-in access to 12 sites (facilities.note), first-come only, 15-day max (confirmed). Added season May 16 - Sep 24 (table: closed Sept 25 to May 16). Cleared max_rig_ft 40 (directory-only; the DNR is silent on length). Phone was missing (flag). Note trimmed of field restatements, the 40-ft claim and 'open roughly mid-April to mid-Sept' (the table says closed until May 16).
